notes.mwasuze: Literally “did you sleep well?”, to an elder.

tips.title: Akiosikin
body: **Akiosikin** is respect. Greet elders first, with **Iperi ejok bo, lokapolon?** Children often bow or kneel to greet elders.

tips.title: Kilomaa ka kiboikin
body: **Kilomaa** is “come in”, **Kiboikin** “sit down”. **Kinyam kidiŋ** offers a little food. **Kiboŋo daŋ!** is “come again!”.

culture.title: Hospitality
body: A guest, **ekaitoŋaon**, is always offered a seat and something to eat or drink. Refusing everything can seem unfriendly.
